quest.title: Fleeting Leisure
quest.description: Noelle, who aims to become a Knight of Favonius, has shared her troubles with you and hopes that you'll be able to help her with her chivalric training. To get the workaholic Noelle some rest, you suggest that the two of you have some tea and let loose a little...

talks.objective: Go to Good Hunter and take a little break

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It shouldn't matter, it's the thought that counts.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Gifts convey our intentions, we should choose carefully.
